1018-5744-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1018-5744-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Roshan, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Skullwinder token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3693-4659-5224-5705.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {2}.
Glaring Fleshraker triggers, creating an Eldrazi Spawn token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Walking Ballista resolves, entering with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

341-4399-4770-8333.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Umori.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Sickbay triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Sickbay trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sickbay trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
341-4399-4770-8333.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

5078-5642-6595.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Echoes of Eternity and Lyse Hext's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Lyse Hext trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Echoes of Eternity trigger, creating a copy of the Sensei's Divining Top spell.
Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2079-4289-4770-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-2783-2841-8103.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Verdant Catacombs.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2783-2841-8103.description:
Fetch a land using Verdant Catacombs.
When the fetched land enters, Nesting Dragon and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3108-3899-6972--112.description:
If Grim Poppet has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.
Resolve all Grim Poppet abilities, putting infinite -1/-1 counters on any number of creatures.
3108-3899-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost toughness by at least 1 to prevent Grim Poppet from dying due to the -1/-1 counters. You can perform this combo as a lock whenever a creature enters the battlefield to put -1/-1 counters on that creature and cause it to die.

728-1734-6132.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2700-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Shikari's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Shikari from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2700-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-5662-6797--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 5.

1090-5998-6867-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4013-7699.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Dread Drone.
When Dread Drone enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1267-5625-7712.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Phelia.
An opponent cannot block Medomai.
1267-5625-7712.description:
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast The Wondrous Wasp by paying {1}{U}.
When The Wondrous Wasp enters, it triggers, tapping Medomai and causing it to lose all its abilities until The Wondrous Wasp leaves the battlefield.
Move to your next turn.
Declare Medomai and Phelia as attackers.
Phelia triggers, exiling The Wondrous Wasp until your end step. This will also cause Medomai to regain its abilities.
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Phelia triggers, returning The Wondrous Wasp from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2511-4535--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat

1170-2440-4055-7517.description:
Cast the copy of Aqueous Aria spell from exile by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, flickering Campus Composer, which enters prepared.
When Campus Composer enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}.
Resolve the spell from step 1, creating a 3/3 Elemental creature token with flying.
When the token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Elemental you control.
Pay an additional {2}{U} to repeat steps 1 through 5 an additional time, this time adding {C}{C}{C} from the Mana Echoes triggers.
Pay an additional {1}{U} to repeat the loop again, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pay an additional {U} to repeat the loop again, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Pay an additional {U} to repeat the loop again, adding six {C}.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding one colored mana.
Repeat steps 1 through 5 and step 10 any number of times.
1170-2440-4055-7517.notes: Mana needed drops significantly for each additional Merfolk, Bard, and Elemental you control.

101-4872-5144.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Vampire Charmseeker and exiling Ephemerate.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1228-3860.easyPrerequisites: Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
1228-3860.description:
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls.
The creature dealt damage dies as a state based action due to having 1 toughness and 1 damage dealt to it. 
Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping Goblin Sharpshooter.
Repeat as desired.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1456-2034-5078-7028.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

851-2034-5220-5631-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
851-2034-5220-5631-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

862-2511-5220-6900.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

4050-5220-5946.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana or less.
4050-5220-5946.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers.
4050-5220-5946.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-413-1379-4853.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
When the Elementals enter, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

2957-4508-5184-5880.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

3384-4067-4435-6827.easyPrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
3384-4067-4435-6827.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, tapping Spider-Gwen.
Spider-Gwen triggers, causing you to discard a card and draw four cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Spider-Gwen.
Repeat.

650-4050-6553.easyPrerequisites: Unhallowed Pact attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
650-4050-6553.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Repeat.

3490-4050-4506-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4050-4506-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Auriok Champion indestructible.
3490-4050-4506-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

372-3647-4823.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Displace exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3647-4823.description:
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Timeless Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Timeless Witness trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Displace.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Timeless Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Driver of the Dead

624-2777-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Phantasmal Image, adding {R}.
When Phantasmal Image dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
Repeat.

799-966-2598-5261.description:
Cast Karn's Temporal Sundering by paying {4}{U}{U}.
The Sixth Doctor triggers, copying Karn's Temporal Sundering.
Resolve the copy of Karn's Temporal Sundering, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Holding priority, activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Unsubstantiate without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Unsubstantiate, returning the original Karn's Temporal Sundering to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1308-1766-2043-3499.description:
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Thran Dynamo that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
Activate both Thran Dynamo tokens' abilities by tapping them, adding six {C}.
Repeat from step 2.

215-2397-2972-5130.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional artifact, enchantment and/or token.
215-2397-2972-5130.description:
Cast Realm-Scorcher Hellkite by paying {4}{R}{R} and sacrificing another artifact, enchantment or token.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite enters the battlefield, it and Ganax trigger twice.
Resolve both Realm-Scorcher Hellkite triggers, adding {5}{R}{R}{G}.
Resolve both Ganax triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Realm-Scorcher Hellkite to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and use Realm-Scorcher Hellkite to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

3090-3722-3903.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying {2}{R}, giving control of Colfenor's Plans to an opponent.
Whenever the opponent that controls Colfenor's Plans casts a spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling that spell.
Because Colfenor's Plans prevents the opponent from casting more than one spell each turn, the opponent cannot cast the spell permitted by Knowledge Pool, or any other spell that turn.

3129-4385-5231.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating two 1/1 Sliver creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing both Slivers, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

570-2011-3970.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
You control a blue and a black permanent.
Opponents can not block and kill creatures you control.
570-2011-3970.description:
Attack with Najeela, Faeburrow Elder, and Militia Rallier.
Najeela and Militia Rallier trigger.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Militia Rallier trigger, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

876-2459-4763-5147.description:
Equip Rograkh with Lightning Greaves.
Sacrifice Rograkh to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage to any target.
Koll triggers, returning Rograkh to you hand.
Cast Rograkh.
Repeat.

2901-3846.notablePrerequisites:
Atemsis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least six different cards with different mana values between your hand and creature cards in library.
An opponent cannot block and kill Atemsis.
2901-3846.description:
Cast Weird Harvest by paying at most {6}{G}{G}, searching your library for at most six creature cards with differing mana values, putting them into your hand, and allowing each opponent to do the same.
Move to your combat phase, and deal combat damage to an opponent with Atemsis.
Atemsis triggers, revealing your hand and causing the opponent dealt combat damage to lose the game.

387-411-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control less than four Thrulls.
387-411-5231.description:
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {2}{R}.
Endrek Sahr triggers, creating three Thrull tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Thrull tokens, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
